start: Sign-in page, Forgot PIN, "Verify with WhatsApp"

steps.action: Type the mobile number and tap Verify with WhatsApp
user_sees: WhatsApp opens with "MettleUp code 123456. After you send this, go back to the MettleUp page."
must_not: A code sent by us (a paid send)
The code shown for a number other than the one typed

steps.action: Send the message, go back to the page
user_sees: "Checking your message…", then verified; choose a new PIN
WhatsApp reply: "Your phone number is successfully verified for MettleUp. Go back to the MettleUp page to finish."
must_not: Verified when the message came from another number

start: Sign-in page, "Set up a new gym"

steps.action: Verify the number the same way (purpose signup)
user_sees: Verified; set-up carries on
must_not: A Forgot PIN proof accepted for set-up

steps.action: Send the code from a different phone
user_sees: The page says wrong number and keeps waiting; after 5 wrong messages it stops (too many)
must_not: Verified
The other phone's number shown

steps.action: Type a number that is not an Indian mobile
user_sees: Refused (BAD_PHONE)
must_not: WhatsApp opened with a code

start: A code is waiting; the owner taps Verify again

steps.action: Send the first (old) code
user_sees: Not verified; the reply asks to send the message without changes
must_not: The old code still works

steps.action: Wait more than 10 minutes without sending
user_sees: Expired
must_not: Verified later from a stale code

steps.action: The page asks for the result again after it got the proof
user_sees: Verified, with no proof the second time
must_not: The proof handed out twice
The number kept stored after the proof is given

steps.action: Verify with WhatsApp and send the message
user_sees: Verified; choose a new PIN
must_not: Verified for a number that is not this staff person's

steps.action: Send a WhatsApp message with no code
user_sees: The page shows a "no code" hint
Reply: "We could not find your MettleUp code in this message. Go back to the MettleUp page, tap "Open WhatsApp again" and send the message without changes."
must_not: Verified
The message text logged

steps.action: The page asks again after the proof
user_sees: Verified without a second proof
must_not: A second proof for the same tap

start: Member app, "Find my gym by my number"

steps.action: Start the check (purpose member)
user_sees: WhatsApp opens with "MettleUp code 123456. After you send this, go back to the MettleUp app."
must_not: The words say "page" for the app

steps.action: Send it, go back to the app
user_sees: Verified
Reply: "Your phone number is successfully verified for MettleUp. Go back to the MettleUp app to finish."
must_not: A code sent to the member by us

steps.action: Type a number with a foreign country code
user_sees: Refused (BAD_PHONE)
must_not: WhatsApp opened with a code

start: A check is waiting; the member sends an edited message with no code

steps.action: Send the message without the code
user_sees: The app shows a "no code" hint
WhatsApp reply tells them what to do next in the app
must_not: Reply tells an app user to "Go back to the MettleUp page" and tap "Open WhatsApp again"
Verified

steps.action: Look at what is kept
user_sees: Only keyed hashes of the number and code; the number sealed until the proof is handed out, then emptied
must_not: The plain number or code in D1 or the logs (only the last 2 digits)

start: "Become a member" page app.mettleup.fit/m/CODE on a phone

steps.action: Type the mobile number, verify with WhatsApp (purpose join)
user_sees: WhatsApp opens with the code and "go back to the MettleUp page"
must_not: A paid send to the visitor

steps.action: Send it and go back
user_sees: Verified; the join form carries on
must_not: Verified from another number

start: JOIN_HOST set: the page on join.mettleup.fit/m/CODE

steps.action: Verify the number from the join host
user_sees: The same check works there (allowed path)
must_not: "Not here" for the phone-code calls on the join host

start: A bot fills the hidden "website" box

steps.action: Start the check
user_sees: A normal-looking answer; its status says expired
must_not: A row stored or a WhatsApp reply for the bot

steps.action: Send the message after 10 minutes
user_sees: Expired; the visitor starts again
must_not: Verified from an expired code

steps.action: Finish joining
user_sees: The proof is handed out once and the stored number emptied
must_not: The number kept after the proof
The number in logs
